description: This Java class configures Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) for a Spring Boot application. It defines a bean that sets up CORS policies such as allowed origins, HTTP methods, headers, and other CORS-related settings to facilitate API access from specified domains and improve client interaction.

classes.name: CorsConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class for setting up CORS filter.

methods.name: corsFilter
methods.description: Creates and returns a CorsFilter bean configured with allowed origins, methods, headers, and other CORS settings for the application.
